title: Robredo, Salceda families remember departed loved ones on All Saints’ Day

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — The families of Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo and Presidential Legislative Liaison Office (PLLO) Secretary Joey Salceda visited the graves of their departed loved ones in Camarines Sur and Albay on Sunday, Nov. 1, in observance of All Saints’ Day. Salceda visited the Garden of Faith in Barangay Sugcad, Polangui, Albay, where his parents and brother are buried. He paid tribute to his mother, Cielo Adelina Sarte Salceda; his father, former Polangui Mayor Jesus Salceda (known to town residents as Tiyo Jess); and his brother, Reymond Salceda.
